title: Turkish Crunchy Warm Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful Turkish-inspired dish that combines crunchy textures with a warm, comforting bowl.

5. In a separate bowl, whisk together the hummus, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
6. Add the roasted vegetables, pickled onions, and parsley to the bowl and toss to combine.
7. To assemble the bowls, place a layer of toasted pita bread on the bottom, followed by a scoop of the falafel.
